title: Add entry-level repository operations backed by positional writes
outcome: Appending and replacing an entry are domain operations on the repository, implemented as positional writes, so one bad value can no longer reject a set that was already recorded.
acceptanceCriteria: IGameRepository exposes appendEntry and replaceEntry; update() carries a comment stating it serves set-level writes only and that new paths must not use it.
An entry carrying a value the database cannot store fails with a 400 and leaves every previously recorded entry in that set intact.
A write against a missing game reports GAME_NOT_FOUND and a write against a missing set reports SET_NOT_FOUND, distinguished by matched versus modified counts rather than by an in-memory check.
Use case tests for the three entry paths mock no database concept, which is the check that database syntax stayed inside GameRepositoryImpl.
repository-helpers.mongo.ts is renamed to error-translation.mongo.ts with no behaviour change.
